subject: biology

hotspots.label: Outer membrane
hotspots.description: The rounded outer membrane that wraps the whole chloroplast and lets materials in and out.
hotspots.positionHint: The smooth outer shell of the chloroplast.

hotspots.label: Stroma (fluid)
hotspots.description: The fluid space inside the chloroplast that fills around the stacks of discs.
hotspots.positionHint: The open fluid area between the grana stacks.
hotspots.function: Fluid that holds the grana and makes the food.

hotspots.label: Grana (disc stacks)
hotspots.description: The stacks of flat green discs (thylakoids) where the light-powered reactions happen.
hotspots.positionHint: The green coin/stacc stacks standing upright in the middle.
hotspots.function: Catch the light and start making the food.

hotspots.label: Chlorophyll
hotspots.description: The green pigment visible on the discs that captures sunlight energy.
hotspots.positionHint: The vibrant green tint coating the grana.

hotspots.label: Food + oxygen out
hotspots.description: The sugar food and the oxygen the chloroplast outputs at the end of photosynthesis.
hotspots.positionHint: Small dots of food (gold) and oxygen (pale) leaving the chloroplast base.
hotspots.function: Sends out the sugar and releases the oxygen.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A clean stylized organelle - rounded green form, muted pale greens holding the disc stacks, not cartoon, not cluttered, no glow. Strong color only on the hotspot dots and the small food-oxygen dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.55. The chlorophyll tint is a material color, never emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a single oval green chloroplast cut open, with stacks of flat green thylakoid discs (grana) upright in a fluid stroma, an outer membrane, and small golden sugar and pale oxygen dots leaving the base. Restrained muted-green on warm cream. Named nodes: OuterMembrane, ThylakoidStack, Stroma, ChlorophyllDisc, FoodOut, OxygenOut. Budget 10-14k.
